messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Distinguish canonical ownership from customers, suppliers, projections, and runtime use. Do not invent authority or collapse sovereign settlements.

Recommend the minimum lawful service/program architecture for this admitted Leader direction: create one Union-wide professional doctrine and curriculum for programming; use the Union Officer Academy (UOA) for reusable repertoire and formation; place programming practice and scripts with Red Cup Engineering's Software Development Services Section (SDSS); offer Relation Model Notation (RMN) as a separately contractable service under Lenticule Science's Obsmetrological Services Section (OSS); and have software-development providers contract RMN when it is the cheapest sufficient way to express pure internal semantics. Corpus constraints: (1) UOA law says it canonically owns reusable offices, duties, works, disciplines, curricula, characters, and executable skills, but receiver-specific service law and protected context stay with the receiver. UOA already says a request to 'make this script' becomes a SoftwareDevelopmentWorkLot tendered to SDSS; UOA may not write RCE territory. (2) SDSS law says it supplies contractible software development and operation; every operation starts from a typed customer purpose, provider-authored offer, and attenuated capability, and ends with a digest-bound proposed product or refusal; child enterprises remain independently contractable. (3) OSS law says it is a Sovereign State Enterprise with explicit service membranes; Obsmetrologia is a pure-mathematics supplier; application code must not enter the primary Lean library. OSS already has a Hoare Program Measurement application micro-enterprise, which imports proved Obsmetrologia declarations and owns program-specific formal measurement, and OML, which develops the pure mathematical library for Obsmetrologia rather than application languages. (4) MetroPlat contains substantial RMN prior art: typed JSON s-expression AST, validator, evaluator, checker, reader, projector, catalog, packets, stdlib, JSNode bridge, Chu/pairing, CRDT/CALM/cohomology measurements, and tests. RMN is intended as canonical typed wire/IR for pure structure-to-structure morphisms; host TypeScript owns effects. Existing notes distinguish human Relation Modeling Language source from traveling RMN. (5) Desired EVM architecture uses human Lisp/Racket surface -> canonical typed RMN -> normalization/type/cost checks -> restricted compiler to Solidity/Yul -> solc -> EVM bytecode; Solidity owns EVM effects. (6) Settlement boundaries prohibit one enterprise writing another's plate. Determine exact owner of: RMN normative specification and conformance suite; RMN evaluator/compiler service; programming professional doctrine and curricula; general executable programming skills; SDSS delivery scripts; MetroPlat source assets; mathematical proofs; EVM backend. Name contracts between owners. Identify whether RMN should be a new OSS child service rather than OML or Hoare Program Measurement. Give a smallest real proof that exercises UOA formation, SDSS procurement, RMN service use, and a customer-owned acceptance/refusal without creating an ambient runtime.
